title: PVP Dummys
description: Easy and Geared Dummys to Pratice on
body: PVP Dummys adds a variety of training dummys and recognizable characters to Minecraft, making combat practice and roleplay more fun than ever! Spawn PvP dummys to test weapons, practice your aim, improve your fighting skills, or experiment with different strategies. The mod also includes characters inspired by popular Minecraft YouTubers and Minecraft: Story Mode, allowing you to create unique adventures, custom maps, battles, and story-driven experiences. Whether you're preparing for PvP, building a roleplay world, or just looking to add more life to your game, PVP Dummys provides plenty of new characters to interact with and enjoy. Train, battle, explore, and create your own stories with this exciting addition to Minecraft!
